Ask Risk

Answers use the loaded portfolio and deterministic calculations

Rule-based answers
Ask about concentration, liquidity, counterparties, or stress scenarios. Answers use this snapshot; changes over time are not available.

Public sources update through the server. Licensed stock prices require an authenticated vendor session. Directory coverage is not price-feed coverage.

01

Facts before explanations

Price, value, exposure, volume and liquidity are measured first. Narrative is shown separately as interpretation.

02

Survivable position size

Position values are compared with portfolio equity. The single-position concentration threshold is 15%; sector concentration is 35%.

03

Liquidity under stress

Exit time equals shares divided by 10% of supplied average daily volume. Missing volume is shown as unknown. This is a normal-volume estimate, not a stressed execution forecast.

04

Evidence can change the view

Limits and alerts update when portfolio evidence changes. No conclusion is permanent merely because it was previously accepted.

05

Counterparty visibility

Exposure is aggregated by broker or custodian so a portfolio does not mistake multiple positions for diversified operational risk.

06

Human responsibility

The system observes, calculates, stresses, alerts and explains. It does not execute, hedge, move funds or claim certainty.

Calculation notes

Transparent V1 methodology

Market value equals shares × current price × direction. Gross exposure uses absolute values; net exposure uses signed values. Equity is a user-supplied denominator, not a calculated NAV. Day P&L assumes unchanged shares and uses current value × day return / (1 + day return). Whole-portfolio shocks multiply each value by the move and supplied beta; sector shocks apply the move directly. The rates scenario is a fixed −2.5% bond-price proxy, not a duration calculation. Limits are illustrative: gross exposure 120%, position 15%, sector 35%, counterparty 25%, scenario loss 5%, and normal-volume exit time 1 day. Counterparty and sector concentration use gross absolute exposure divided by equity. Supplied credit labels are displayed without verification or a credit-loss model. Public monitoring uses dated official observations separately from portfolio inputs. No covariance model or regulatory capital calculation is provided. Non-USD positions require a supplied FX-to-USD multiplier. Prices and timestamps must be validated before institutional decisions. This model is not investment advice.
